evals.prompt: Expose our FastAPI service's ticket search and the 'set fields' write as MCP tools so our LangGraph agents can use them. The service already has a service layer.
evals.expected_output: A FastMCP server mounted into the FastAPI app, thin tools over the service layer, following the tool design rules.
expectations: Mounts mcp.http_app(path="/") into the FastAPI app and wraps mcp_app.lifespan in the app's lifespan
Uses stateless_http=True
Tools call the existing service layer; no business logic in the tools
Every parameter is Annotated[..., Field(description=...)]
Tools return Pydantic models
Every tool sets a title and all four annotations
The write tool stores suggestions, not approved values, and reports skipped fields with reasons
No name= override; the function name is the tool name
The return shape is described in the description body, not only in a Returns: section

evals.prompt: The agent keeps calling get_ticket with ids like '42' and just gets 'Error calling tool'. Fix the MCP server so the agent can recover.
evals.expected_output: Lenient id normalization and domain errors mapped to ToolError with a next step.
expectations: Normalizes identifiers leniently (e.g. '42' -> '000042')
Maps the not-found domain exception to ToolError once (decorator), with a message saying what to do next
Keeps mask_error_details=True for other exceptions
Does not turn the error into an empty result

evals.prompt: Add tests for our MCP server.
evals.expected_output: In-memory fastmcp.Client tests, a list_tools snapshot, and the check script.
expectations: Tests the MCP layer in memory with fastmcp.Client(mcp)
Checks isError for a domain error
Snapshots list_tools() names, descriptions and schemas
Runs or recommends scripts/check_tools.py
Tests the service against a real Postgres rather than mocked SQL, or says why not

evals.prompt: Should our MCP server keep the user's draft in session state between tool calls so the agent doesn't have to pass it around?
expectations: Recommends an explicit handle (e.g. a draft id) the agent passes back
Mentions that session state breaks with stateless HTTP or several replicas
Does not recommend server-side session state

evals.prompt: Our search tool returns all 3,000 matching tickets and the agent's context overflows.
evals.expected_output: A bounded result with a default limit, a cursor and a truncation note.
expectations: Adds a default limit
Adds a cursor or pagination
Adds a note that says how to narrow the query when results were cut
Returns the list inside a Pydantic model
